source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-fdupe-same-uuid-twice-is-not-ambiguous.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: The census is a Set of uuids, so the SAME product resolved at two match tiers collapses to one entry and must NOT be excluded. Without the Set semantics every multi-tier match would look cross-company and the annotation would vanish on ordinary traffic.
